name: Recovery of a Child — Unlawful Custodial Transfer, Cross-Tier Jurisdiction
posted_by: Miriam Ssali-Park (private individual, Tier 2) — posted through Ghost-tier intermediary, authenticated by Senior Broker Callum Osei
target: Lena Ssali-Park, 7 years old — taken from Tier 2 school grounds eleven days ago by Harlan Park (biological father) and currently held within the Vireau Group's privately managed residential enclave, Tier 5, GLMZ North Corridor
objective: Enter the Vireau Group residential enclave, locate Lena Ssali-Park, confirm she is unharmed, and extract her safely and without injury to her or any other child in the facility. Return her to her mother.
location: Vireau Group Managed Residential Enclave — Lakeshore Heights, Tier 5 private territory, GLMZ North Corridor; access by invitation only; perimeter maintained by Vireau's proprietary security force
payout: Φ1,200,000 — Miriam Ssali-Park has liquidated everything she has; the remainder of the payout is covered by an undisclosed third party who Osei has personally vetted
deadline: Harlan Park's attorney has filed for emergency custodial determination in a private arbitration forum the Vireau Group sponsors; ruling expected in 8 days; if ruling is issued first, extraction becomes a recovery of a legally 'settled' matter
complications: The Vireau Group's residential enclave is genuinely sovereign territory by private charter — Arcturus Civil Security has no authority inside the perimeter and has formally declined jurisdiction; any security contact inside is governed only by Vireau's internal protocols, which include permanent exclusion and civil pursuit for unauthorized entry

Harlan Park is a Tier 5 resident and a Vireau Group stakeholder; he has not committed a crime that any accessible legal system will act on within the relevant timeframe — the extraction is extralegal by definition

Lena Ssali-Park has been inside the enclave for eleven days with a father she knows; she may not understand she needs to leave, may be frightened of the person extracting her, or may have been told a version of events that complicates her cooperation
description:
Callum Osei authenticated this personally, which means he confirmed Miriam Ssali-Park is who she says she is and that the money is real. The intermediary structure exists because Miriam has already been turned away by two private investigation firms and one legal advocacy office, all of whom assessed the Vireau Group's private charter status as prohibitive. She is not naive about what she's asking for. The posting reaches S-tier not because the violence is complex but because the institutional architecture around the target makes everything else inadequate.

Harlan Park is Lena's biological father and Miriam's ex-partner. Their separation was not resolved through any court — Tier 2 residents do not have reliable access to civil arbitration, and Harlan's Tier 5 status meant any proceedings defaulted to forums he could afford and she couldn't. He took Lena from school on a Tuesday. There were no formal custody orders that Miriam had access to enforce. Inside the Vireau enclave, Lena is not being physically harmed — she is being raised, by her father, in a Tier 5 environment, with resources Miriam cannot match. Harlan's position is that this is better for Lena. Miriam's position is that Lena is her child and she did not consent. The private arbitration forum Harlan's attorney has filed with is one where Vireau Group has two sitting members. The ruling will be what Harlan needs it to be. The contractor walking into this job is being asked to take a child from a man who will describe himself as a father, in a building full of other children, in the most legally protected private space in GLMZ North — and the moral clarity of the objective does not make the operational reality any simpler.
story_hooks: Lena has been told her mother sent her here for safety — she has a specific, detailed story that Harlan told her, and unwinding it in a crisis moment will require more than the contractor may have time or skill for

The undisclosed third party covering the remainder of the payout is someone with their own history with the Vireau Group — their motive for helping is real but not purely altruistic, and Osei knows more than he has said
